responsibility: Local authoritative terminal-execution service for one trusted Desktop broker, owning retained terminal lifecycle, PTY and process trees, canonical Ghostty state, attachment-scoped input, projection, history, and selection, and the private local IPC endpoint.
nonGoals: Owning Project, Workspace, Workbench, Tab, Panel, agent, or product-session models.
Owning Electron lifecycle, product recovery or update policy, presentation, renderer behavior, or platform UI effects.
Owning concurrent independent brokers, same-user application isolation, or multi-tenant authorization.
Providing durable PTY migration or recovery across Host-process or operating-system crashes.
Owning network listeners, remote authentication, encryption, or sharing gateway behavior.
